name: clang_format
description: Format C and C++ sources to the project's .clang-format

read.help: OVERVIEW: A tool to format C/C++/Java/JavaScript/JSON/Objective-C/Protobuf/C# code.

help: OVERVIEW: A tool to format C/C++/Java/JavaScript/JSON/Objective-C/Protobuf/C# code.
- If set, changes formatting warnings to errors
- If set, don't error out on the specified warning type
- Set filename used to determine the language and to find .clang-format file
- The position of the cursor when invoking clang-format from an editor integration
- If set, do not actually make the formatting changes
- Dump configuration options to stdout and exit
- If set, fail with exit code 1 on incomplete format
- The name of the predefined style used as a fallback in case clang-format is invoked with -style=file, but can not find the .clang-format file to use
- Set the maximum number of clang-format errors to emit before stopping (0 = no limit)
- A file containing a list of files to process, one per line
- Display list of available options (--help-list-hidden for more)
- Inplace edit <file>s, if specified
- Format a range of this length (in bytes)
- <start line>:<end line> - format a range of lines (both 1-based)
- Alias for --dry-run
- Format a range starting at this byte offset
- Output replacements as XML
determined by the QualifierAlignment style flag
- If set, overrides the include sorting behavior determined by the SortIncludes style flag
- Set coding style
- If set, shows the list of processed files
